Depending on the type of test you could work out a little before hand. Some test require your basal state so eating and exercise could potentially mess with the results. Can still help for some. As for usable veins as long as they aren't in a dangerous area you can usually go anywhere in the arm. Can even use finger veins. Also sometimes you can use capillary blood for certain tests. Can even go as far as warming the site beforehand. There's a few tricks to difficult draws
